[size=4][b]Updated 11/27/2024, version 1.0.1[/b][/size]

I've updated Robin's and Demetrius's portrait. Robin's portrait is a pixelated version of her official art, I hand drawn Demetrius's.


[size=4][b]Updated 11/25/2024, version 1.0[/b][/size]

In this mod, you will be able to change Robin's and Demetrius's sprite.

In 1.0, only the Robin.xnb and Demetrius.xnb sprites will change, I will be working on other seasonal sprites and portraits soon.
Apart from their little dance together being changed into Robin singing and Origami bird dancing, all of their interactions and events (like Demetrius's green rain outfit) will stay the same.


[size=4][b][u]The sprites and portraits DO NOT use SMAPI or CP, here's how to download:[/u][/b][/size]

1. Back up your files (e.g. Robin.xnb and Demetrius.xnb)   (steam/steamapps/common/stardew valley/content/characters(or portrait))

2. Copy (or move) the file from the mod to the characters folder.[b] ALWAYS remember to change the file name to match the one that you’re replacing[/b]. Choose [u]replace files[/u] if a window pops up.

3. Run the game, since it's not a SMAPI or CP mod, you can run the game with or without SMAPI, just note that it won't update the dialogues.
